title: feat(studio): per-object API / Hooks / Actions tabs + Data-pillar polish
body:
## What

Object-centric Studio (Data pillar) gains three per-object tabs and a real-user polish pass.

### New object tabs
- **API** — the object's five auto-generated REST endpoints, derived from its draft schema, with copy-as-cURL and a schema-derived example body. Reference-only.
- **Hooks** — read-only inventory of lifecycle hooks targeting the object (events / condition / priority / async).
- **Actions** — master-detail: a list of the object's actions on the left, and the **real** `action` metadata form (`getMetadataDefaultInspector('action')`) on the right. Create (**+ New**) / edit / delete; edits write back into the object's inline `actions[]` and persist via Save draft (same model as Validations). Object-scoped only; global actions are out of scope.

Tab order: `Records · Form · Validations · Hooks · Actions · API · Settings`.

### Polish (real-user lens)
- **Object icons** — the Data rail and header now show each object's own `icon` (via `getIcon`), not a generic Database glyph.
- **Segmented control** — the object tab layer was faint toolbar chrome; reworked to the design-system segmented idiom (recessed track + elevated active pill).
- **Declutter** — removed internal-architecture jargon badges ("Runtime list · same renderer", "Preview = runtime · same renderer") across Data/Interfaces; softened the uppercase type tags (OBJECT/PROFILE, form field types) from filled grey chips to faint labels; de-jargoned copy; promoted the object header to a real title; dropped the API subtitle's reference to a not-yet-existent "Developer console".

### Bugs found & fixed via browser testing
- **Hook condition crash** — a hook `condition` may be `{ dialect, source }`, not a string; rendering it raw white-screened the tree. Coerce to `.source`. (tsc couldn't catch it.)
- **New action unsavable** — an unseeded `type:'script'` skeleton 422s the object draft on body edit (`body.language` discriminator). Seed a runnable JS body — same class the validations panel avoids with a placeholder condition.

## Test
- `tsc --noEmit` green.
- Scoped vitest (i18n locale parity + studio-design panels): 34 passed.
- Browser-verified end-to-end in a writable package: create → configure an "Archive" action (label / script / placement) → Save draft → reload persists → delete. Empty/populated states for all three tabs verified.
